about_the_game:
Enter the war-torn world of Iveria — where three kingdoms fight for dominance and a hero writes the Fourth Story.

Embark on an epic fantasy MMORPG experience in 4Story: The Original, a classic reborn. Explore the richly woven lore of Iveria, a continent shaped by ancient gods and devastated by celestial wars. Choose your side — DeFugel, Craxion, or Broa — and fight for control in an expansive realm filled with conflict, mystery, and history.

🔥 Key Features:

⚔️ Massive Realm Wars – Battle of Worlds
Take part in large-scale PvP content where up to 49 vs. 49 players clash in strategic warfare between kingdoms. Represent your guild, server, or self in real-time battles that demand teamwork and precision.

🏰 Conquer Territories & Castles
Engage in Territory Wars, Sacred Wars, and Mission Wars where strategic coordination leads to regional control, exclusive rewards, and guild prestige.

🎮 Classic MMORPG Gameplay
Level up, explore instanced dungeons, and participate in memorable story-driven quests that let you relive key events and unravel Iveria’s mythic history.

🛡️ Guild Systems & Progression
Create, grow, and lead your guild to glory. Expand your guild level, manage storage, recruit mercenaries, assign ranks, and earn exclusive guild-wide perks.

🌍 Time Travel & Memory Quests
Relive the past through others' memories and manipulate time with immersive questlines, blending storytelling and gameplay in innovative ways.

💥 Skill-Based PvP and Battlegrounds
Fight in balanced arenas like the Battle Ground where gear is normalized, and success depends on skill and strategy, not stats alone.

🐉 Heroic Lore & Legendary Races
Join the ranks of Warebeasts, Fairies, and Humans, each with unique abilities and histories drawn from Iveria’s past.

🎁 Daily Events and Evolving Content
Participate in seasonal events, unlock exclusive DLCs, and enjoy limited-time events like 200% EXP boosts and unique item drops.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Pentium 4 1.6 GHZ or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel I3 6 Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Between Berkilious, the God of Destruction, and Lea, the Goddess of creation, long-lasting antagonism has repeated numerous creations and destructions. In the name of the Goddess Lea, exists the world of Iveria. In this world of chaos, will there be a hero to end this war once and for all?
supported_languages:
English*, Russian
*languages with full audio support
